title: Review data models with stakeholders
goal: The person who asked the question has seen the model as it is: its answer, its assumptions and its error, has said which assumptions are wrong, and their objections are recorded against the model.

steps.do: Put the model in front of the asker as one page: the question, the answer, the assumptions in plain words, the error on unseen data, and what it cannot tell them.
Ask the asker which assumptions do not match what they know, since only they know the business behind the numbers, and record each answer against the assumption it corrects.
Write each objection with the part of the model it touches and whether it would change the answer, and mark the ones that must be settled before anyone acts on it.
Attach the review and its objections to the decision the analysis serves, and raise whether to refine the model or act on it as it stands.

done_criteria.check: Did the person who asked the question see every assumption in plain words, and is each of their objections recorded against the part of the model it touches?
